note: Commercially he is the textbook case. An architect running his own practice with an international consulting project, an Equinox membership, travel to London, Rome, Berlin, Naples and Capri, and no price resistance whatsoever — 'it's more or less what I thought it would be' — so he passes cleanly on occupation and on affordability. Health is a neglected area rather than an emergency and he is emphatically not the stated exclusion: he trains three to six times a week and is anything but gym-averse. He misses on starting point. A man who cannot perform one push-up, cannot rise from the floor without his hands, and cannot rotate his left shoulder enough to put on a jacket is not going from good to great; he is asking to be brought back from a functional deficit, and his own framing is rebuilding and 'radically increase'. The wider point is the one already recorded in the ICP observations: the stated criteria contain no clinical screen, and this call is the clearest illustration of the cost of that. He is the most financially qualified prospect in this batch and simultaneously the one carrying the most unassessed physical risk, and the criteria as written flag none of it.
